thread:
maria: quick flag - after the hedge/allocator changes rolled the last week i've noticed repeated route churning between us-central and eu-west for a handful of mid-size tenants. p99 jumps when the churn happens.
kevin: any logs or a small repro trace?
maria: dropping a condensed log snippet: 
```
2026-04-02T09:12:02Z choose us-central score=0.68
2026-04-02T09:12:03Z probe eu-west healthy -> bump -> score_eu=0.695
2026-04-02T09:12:04Z commit eu-west preempt=soft
2026-04-02T09:12:06Z probe us-central healthy -> winback -> score_us=0.71
2026-04-02T09:12:07Z commit us-central preempt=soft
```
tara: looks like small deltas + symmetric increments are enough to flip. The allocator treats probe successes and winbacks the same.
oz: are hedged requests sending probes both directions? that could amplify flips if both sides get success signals.
lia (product): customer reported duplicated tokens and a short content mismatch during those flips. Not acceptable for chat flows.
kevin: rough mitigation idea: introduce asymmetric handling: probes update a separate health metric, but winback applies only if health > threshold for N consecutive probes and delta > min_delta. also reduce magnitude of immediate weight change.
maria: agree. maybe implement a two-stage transition: stage 1 soft-weight (10-20%) applied immediately; stage 2 after sustained success promote to full weight.
tara: + tie MAX_RAMP to a tenant volatility score (EWMA of recent score deltas). High-volatility tenants should have smaller MAX_RAMP and longer K.
allocator-bot: /alert flip-rate tenant_set=mid_shard rate=0.21 per_min threshold=0.05
kevin: proposed pseudo: 
```pseudo
health = ewma_probe_success
if health >= HEALTH_THR && consecutive_ok >= K && delta > DELTA_THR:
  new_weight = current + clamp(delta, 0, MAX_RAMP(tenant_vol))
else:
  new_weight = current + delta * SOFT_ALPHA
```
oz: think we should also add a small random jitter when applying soft_alpha so many tenants don't synchronize flips on the same tick.
lia (product): short-term: can we gate a conservative allocator-mode flag that sets SOFT_ALPHA=0.12, K=4? customers are already asking for a hotfix.
maria: yep feature-flag it; runtime-only and per-shard toggle. I'll coordinate rollout.
kevin: i'll prototype the change and run a replay across 72h of traces. who owns replays?
maria: i'll run them and post metrics.
allocator-bot: replay job queued job_id=rp-20260402-17
kevin: also want an integration test in CI that simulates correlated probe noise and asserts flip-rate < X. This should catch regressions before rollouts.
tara: RFC items to follow: (1) expose tenant volatility and health metrics to policy DSL, (2) policy knobs for staged ramping and asymmetric probe vs winback handling, (3) SLA metric for flip-rate and rollback hooks.
lia (product): timeline: short-term feature-flag deploy in 48 hours, RFC by end of sprint, and longer-term: per-tenant adaptive controllers.
maria: action items: kevin implement prototype + unit tests (ETA 2d), maria run full replay and perf check (ETA 1d), ops add flag rollout runbook + per-tenant log stream (ETA 1d), tara draft RFC skeleton (ETA 5d).
oz: note: make sure to document the observable that indicates token duplication (dup_token_count) so support can triage quickly.
